critical_event_due_during_provider_call: event dispatch waits until the provider call returns or times out; no additional fixed post-work sleep is added afterward
historical_running_pid_reason: The live market PID that ran on 2026-08-03 checked ORPT/RC/EOD only when the ordinary poll loop re-entered _run_once().
latest_source_reason: Latest source wakes on the earlier of the next poll deadline or the next critical market-time boundary, but the loop remains single-threaded and critical dispatch can still be delayed by one in-flight provider cycle.
maximum_expected_blocking_time: bounded by the current cycle duration plus the configured provider timeout budget
provider_call_interaction: critical events are checked between cycles; an in-flight provider call can still delay dispatch until the current cycle returns
scheduler_model: single-threaded cooperative loop with earlier-of(poll_deadline, critical_boundary) sleep calculation
